_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: GERBER Printed Wiring Board (PWB) Data
summary: Provides GERBER Printed Wiring Board (PWB) Data that is required for plotted documentation produced during the design phase.
use_relationship: Provides GERBER Printed Wiring Board (PWB) Data that is required for plotted documentation produced during the design phase. This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data generated by the discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract; ANSI/IPC-2221, Generic Standard on Printed Board Design; ANSI/IPC-2222-1998, Sectional Standard on Rigid PWB Design; MIL-PRF-31032/4A, Printed Wiring Board, Rigid Flex or Flexible, Multilayer, with Plated Holes, With or Without Stiffeners, for Soldered Part Mounting; and NSA DS-61, Data Standard for Preparation of Engineering Documentation, Revision F and Appendix B Sections 3.7.5.3.1 through 3.7.5.3.3. This DID is used in conjunction with ANSI/IPC-2221 and ANSI/IPC-2222-1998 and is interrelated to DI-CMAN-80639C and DI-CMAN-80640C.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revision shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of the solicitation, and for non-DODISS-listed documents as stated herein. NSA DS 61, Revision F, and Appendix B, the current edition, is located at the Department of Defense, National Security Agency, 9800 Savage Rd, Fort George G. Meade, Md 20755-6000; Attn: I5221.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall be in the contractor's format.

children.title: The format and content
children.content: shall be in accordance with NSA DS-61, Revision F, and Appendix B, 3.7.5.3.1 through 3.7.5.3.3.

children.title: The Printed Wiring Board (PWB) design requirements
children.content: shall be in accordance with ANSI/IPC-2221, ANSI/IPC-2222-1998, and MIL-PRF-31032/4A.
